design.basis: Illustrative reference hypotheses for mathematical screening; no member selection, measured hardware, load rating or approval

base_interfaces.interpretation: Declared ideal lift/slew/short-slide interfaces and point masses; actual hardware, anchorage, transport and foundation behavior are unmodeled

mass_ledger.scope: All declared bars, floor, rails and node fittings plus two stationary base mass ledgers; omitted hardware is not implicitly massless in reality

mode_definitions.independent_half_cantilevers: No seam ties; all four root-node translations held on each half
mode_definitions.joined_clamped: All four seam-node pairs tied; all root translations still held
mode_definitions.joined_service: All four seam-node pairs tied; four z bearings, two y guides on one global edge, one x restraint
mode_definitions.lower_only_join_after_release: Only the two lower seam pairs tied; permanent service bearings only
mode_definitions.premature_release_before_join: No seam ties; permanent service bearings only
mode_definitions.joined_release_midpoint: All four ties; permanent bearings zero and temporary root translations prescribed at half their service-dead values

checks_not_performed: Reference geometry, areas, material, masses and crowd pressures are declared hypotheses, not observations or selected capacities
Linear pin-jointed axial bars only: no member bending, torsion, buckling, geometric nonlinearity, yielding or fatigue checks
No deck plate, guards, connections, center locks, mast, bearings, actuators, chassis, pads, soil or anchorage capacity model
No dynamic, vibration, impact, wind-on-truss or moving-load response model
The rigid/deformable mode change uses ideal ties and prescribed translations, not a validated physical control sequence
No accessibility, pedestrian layout, transport envelope, fabrication or operational approval
